decisions.reason: Making the branded placard double-sided does not change the machine's DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The placard wording and viewing sides do not change the machine's beige primary color or green accents.
The source decision concerns only the branded placard and does not alter the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication method.
Displaying identical placard wording on both sides has no necessary effect on splash-control behavior or mitigation.
The placard display change does not affect the stainless-steel material requirements for food-contact components.
The source decision does not change the controlled-pour, anti-drip, flow, or beverage-preservation requirements.
The double-sided placard requirement does not alter bowl depth, capacity, geometry, or refill expectations.
The placard change does not affect the solenoid valve or button-controlled dispensing behavior.
Although the placard is mounted on the enclosure, the source does not change the enclosure's size or side-profile constraints.
The placard's two-sided presentation does not affect whisk height or operating position.
References to the product name on the placard do not alter whisk size, material, or head design.
The placard display change has no necessary effect on bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
